_metadata.description: Route preview, execution reasoning, and audit evidence.

requirements.title: Route preview explains provider selection before execution
requirements.description: Given a request role, profile, and constraints, the gateway must show the selected provider path, fallback candidates, rejected candidates, and policy reasons without executing inference.

validation.notes: Validates route preview candidate ordering, policy reasons, and fallback eligibility.
Validates preview RPC applies gateway request validation before routing.

requirements.title: Executed requests produce auditable route evidence
requirements.description: Each execution must emit structured evidence including request intent, role/profile, selected provider role, resource command path, resolved concrete model when available, latency, token/size metadata when available, and failure/fallback details.

validation.notes: Validates persistence and prompt/response redaction behavior for route evidence.
Validates execution fails closed when successful route evidence cannot be persisted.
